verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents both sides of the path: O-1 work visas, with planning of 'next steps early', and a full self-petitioned EB-2 NIW green card service (I-140 drafting, filing, and RFE responses). It also offers strategy selection across paths. However, no evidence explicitly ties the O-1 to a green-card continuation, and EB-1A is never mentioned. missing for 10: EB-1A offering, explicit O-1-to-green-card transition strategy documentation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: The National Interest Waiver lets you petition for a green card on your own when your work serves the national interest of the United States.
We draft your petition, legal brief, and recommendation letters, then file your I-140 with USCIS.
We help employers secure H-1B, L-1, O-1, TN, E, and other work visas
We track expirations and plan extensions, amendments, and next steps early
We help you understand your options and choose the strategy that best showcases your achievements.
